text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mmm... My pillow's in a weird position...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want it to fit around the neck a bit better, you know~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this way... No, it sinks too much.
...If it's here, its position with the blanket is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright, perfect! Now I can get a good night's sle—
Wait, look at the time!?

In her quest for a good night's sleep,
Hishi Miracle got so obsessed with positioning her pillow
that she ended up staying up late...
